verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses entirely on Penpot's MCP server, plugin API, webhooks, self-hosting, components, and pricing — none of it describes built-in generative AI features like image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, or copy suggestions inside the editor itself. The MCP/plugin system enables external AI agents to interact with design files, but that is a different capability (developer/automation integration) than editor-native asset-generation AI tools.
